title: Keto Reuben Cabbage Rolls
description: This makes a total of 4 servings of Keto Reuben Cabbage Rolls. Each serving comes out to be 512 calories, 37.5g fats, 5.3g net carbs, and 25.8g protein.

instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350F and boil some water. Place the cabbage leaves in a large bowl then pour the boiling water over the top. Allow the leaves to sit for 3-5 minutes before removing them. You want the leaves to have a structure to them but be soft enough to manipulate and roll. Set the leaves aside.
In a bowl mix together the mayonnaise, ketchup, garlic, lemon juice, sriracha, onion powder, salt, and pepper to create the thousand island dressing.
In a medium bowl mix together the pastrami, cheese, sauerkraut, and half of the Thousand Island Dressing.

Lay a cabbage leaf out on a cutting board. Spoon 1/8 of the meat mixture into the center of the leaf. Roll up like it’s a burrito, then place seam side down into a baking dish. Repeat this step with the rest of the leaves.
Spread the rest of the dressing across the top of the cabbage rolls, then place the baking dish into the oven and cook for 30 minutes.

video.name: Keto Reuben Cabbage Rolls Recipe
video.description:
Do you love Reuben sandwiches? I love this adult version of grilled cheese. The classic Reuben piles meat, Swiss, sauerkraut, and dressing between slices of grilled rye bread. For simplicity, we replace the bread with cabbage rolls and turn the whole thing into a delicious casserole.

Read the full recipe with full nutrition breakdown and step-by-step pictures over at:

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ingredients:
Cabbage rolls:
8 large cabbage leaves
8 ounces pastrami, chopped up
1½ cups shredded Swiss cheese
½ cup drained sauerkraut

Thousand Island Dressing:
½ cup mayonnaise
¼ cup sugar-free ketchup
1 clove garlic, minced
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
1 tablespoon Sriracha sauce
1 teaspoon onion powder
Salt and pepper, to taste

Nutrition Summary:
This makes a total of 8 servings of Keto Reuben Cabbage Rolls. Each serving comes out to be 230.28 Calories, 17.6g Fats, 3.85g Net Carbs, and 12.52g Protein.
